title: TickFlow 财务数据增量同步到 ClickHouse
notes: 每天把 PostgreSQL lb_financial_report 的新增或更新记录增量迁移到 ClickHouse longbridge.lb_financial_report，并刷新 TickFlow 四张财务 Parquet；使用 5 分钟重叠窗口和 ReplacingMergeTree 幂等去重。
script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
TICKFLOW_ROOT=/home/alwin/apps/tickflow-stock-panel
MIGRATION_PYTHON=/home/alwin/apps/longbridge-stock/.venv/bin/python
export POSTGRES_FINANCIAL_DSN='dbname=longbridge_stock user=alwin host=/var/run/postgresql'
export CLICKHOUSE_URL='http://127.0.0.1:8123'
export CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE='longbridge'
export FINANCIAL_MIGRATION_CHECKPOINT="$TICKFLOW_ROOT/data/sync_state/financial_clickhouse.json"
"$MIGRATION_PYTHON" "$TICKFLOW_ROOT/backend/scripts/sync_financials_pg_to_clickhouse.py" --batch-size 20000
docker exec -i TickFlow_Stock_Panel /app/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from app.services.financial_sync import sync_all
from app.tickflow.capabilities import CapabilitySet
print(sync_all(Path('/app/data'), CapabilitySet()))
PY
